hero.title: Physiotherapy in Spain for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Study Physiotherapy in Spain (Grado en Fisioterapia) to earn a 4-year, 240 ECTS European rehabilitation degree combining biomechanics, musculoskeletal therapy, and supervised hospital clinical placements.

overview: Physiotherapy in Spain for Indian students offers a structured European healthcare education focused on human movement, musculoskeletal rehabilitation, neurorehabilitation, sports therapy, and patient recovery.

In Spain, the standard undergraduate physiotherapy qualification is the Grado en Fisioterapia, which typically spans 4 years (240 ECTS credits) and integrates academic coursework with extensive supervised clinical practice.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide helps Indian students compare Spanish universities, verify language and academic eligibility, prepare documents, and plan their student visa application.

sections.title: Why Study Physiotherapy in Spain?
sections.lead: Spain combines European higher-education standards with practical clinical training in rehabilitation hospitals, sports clinics, and community healthcare.

items: 4-Year 240 ECTS Degree: Structured Grado en Fisioterapia curriculum aligned with European healthcare standards.

Affordable Public Tuition: Public universities offer comparatively lower tuition than many private European institutions.

sections.title: Eligibility for Physiotherapy in Spain
sections.lead: Indian students must satisfy academic, science-subject, credential-recognition, and language requirements.

items: Completion of Class 12 (or equivalent) with Biology and Chemistry.
Academic credential homologation / UNEDasiss assessment where required by Spanish public universities.
Spanish language proficiency (B2 level or equivalent) for Spanish-taught clinical programmes, or English proof where an English track is offered.
Valid passport and complete academic transcripts.

faqs.q: How long is the Physiotherapy degree in Spain?
faqs.a: In Spain, the undergraduate Grado en Fisioterapia typically takes 4 years (240 ECTS credits) including supervised clinical placements.

faqs.q: Can Indian students study Physiotherapy in Spain?
faqs.a: Yes, Indian students with Class 12 science subjects can apply if they meet academic, credential evaluation, and language requirements.

faqs.q: Are Physiotherapy courses in Spain taught in English?
faqs.a: Most undergraduate physiotherapy programmes are taught primarily in Spanish because clinical placements involve direct patient care, though select private universities offer bilingual or English-supported tracks.

faqs.q: What are the tuition fees for Physiotherapy in Spain?
faqs.a: Public universities typically charge around €1,500 to €6,500 per year for non-EU students, while private universities generally range from €6,000 to €12,000+ per year.

faqs.q: Can I practice in India after studying Physiotherapy in Spain?
faqs.a: Not automatically. Graduates must verify foreign qualification recognition and registration rules with the relevant Indian healthcare/physiotherapy regulatory authorities before enrolling.
